_readme: Contact weights from the Through-time maps (scripts/contact-strength.js, rebuilt after each Through-time build). "arrows": a strength for each chart arrow the maps confirm (1 = typical, the Norman conquest of England about 3). "map": rule the chart has no arrow for, 200+ years over 25%+ of the speakers' land, between families; it lends words like an arrow. "veto": ids of map contacts to ignore (kept from build to build). A strength set on a chart arrow itself wins.
